title: shape
description: A named object type. layer says who may speak it: edge shapes are what the outside world imposes and only triggers and the data layer may name them; core shapes are the project's own. unknown is legal only in edge shapes.

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/shape.schema.json.

description.description: What this shape is, in one or two sentences.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

layer.description: Who may speak this shape: edge for what the outside world imposes, which only triggers and the data layer may name; core for the business's own.
